headword: {台所用品|だいどころようひん}

definitions.gloss: kitchenware; kitchen supplies; kitchen utensils and goods
definitions.explanation: A general term for items used in the kitchen, including cooking utensils, pots, pans, cutting boards, and other kitchen tools and supplies.

examples.japanese: {台所用品|だいどころようひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{台所用品|だいどころようひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This store has a wide selection of kitchenware.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めるとき、⟦{最低限|さいていげん}→最低限：13056_saiteigen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{台所用品|だいどころようひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえる⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧ (kitchen) and ⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧ (supplies/goods). The suffix ～⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧ is productive: ⟦{事務用品|じむようひん}→事務用品：17436_jimuyouhin⟧ (office supplies), ⟦{日用品|にちようひん}→日用品：09547_nichiyouhin⟧ (daily necessities), ⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧・{学用品|がくようひん} (school supplies).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台所用品|だいどころようひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (kitchenware section)
- {台所用品|だいどころようひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえる (to stock up on kitchenware)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧: same meaning using the English-derived word for kitchen
- ⟦{調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}→調理器具：14991_chourikigu⟧: cooking utensils/tools — more specifically about tools used for cooking
